messages.subject: eclipse doesn't show StatET perspective
messages.body_plain:
[Env: Win 7]

I had problems with a prior installation of Eclipse 4.3 (Kepler) and 
decided to reinstall from scratch.  I downloaded and unziped
eclipse-standard-kepler-SR2-win32-x86_64.zip,
ran eclipse.exe, and from Help -> Install new software
installed StatET from
http://download.walware.de/eclipse-4.3

After eclipse restarted, I get the cheat sheet for StatET,
but  Window > Preferences > General > Perspectives
does not show StatET as an available perspective.

What could be wrong?  How can I fix this?

thanks

messages.subject: Ctrl+Alt+Up/Down don't work in RJ console
messages.subject_clean: Ctrl+Alt+Up/Down don't work in RJ console
messages.body_plain:
Greetings,

When running R in command line environment I extensively use `reverse-i-search' feature to quick search a commands' history.
This feature is enabled by Ctrl+R in command line.
I was told that the same is available via Ctrl+Alt+Up/Down key combination in Eclipse/StatET RJ console.
I recently installed Eclipse Mars + StatET and all required for Eclipse and R integration on my machine running Linux and noticed that
Ctrl+Alt+Up/Down don't work. They just do nothing. When I brought up a list of available shortkeys via Ctrl+Shift+L I noticed Ctrl+Alt+Up/Down listed twice, one for copying a line up/down and the other one to search a history.
However, neither one works for me.

Could someone give me clue how to fix it?

Thanks,

Slava

Hi,

I used to use Ctrl+Alt+up/down all the time, but at some point it stopped working (months ago).  I'm currently running Luna with StatET 3.4 under Windows server 12, but it hasn't worked on other installations either.

I also had conflicting assignments for those short cuts, but deleting the other one as you suggested didn't fix the problem.

Sorry that I can't be more helpful, but wanted to chime in that's it's not restricted to the config Slava described...

Thanks-- all your work is much appreciated!
Mike

messages.subject: Re: Ctrl+Alt+Up/Down don't work in RJ console
messages.subject_clean: Ctrl+Alt+Up/Down don't work in RJ console
messages.body_plain:
Wait a minute-- I figured out that this key combination was being used by the windows "hot keys" (because I noticed that if I hit the up arrow twice it would flip my display)

To disable the hot key feature, I right-clicked on the desktop, selected "Graphics Options" then "Hot Keys" then disable.  

Unfortunately this only worked on my laptop, running Windows 7; haven't been able to find the problem under Windows Server 12. No idea whether this has any relevance on Linux, but it might be a similar issue where the binding is being set at the OS level-- hope this helps.

Thanks,
Mike
